paraphrase_en: Gelfond (AHTI 2020) attributes the 'open and closed folds' shaping techniques to Raffaelli and cites The Fast Guide to Architectural Form (BIS, 2016), p. 49, in footnote [14].
Russian-language article by Gelfond lists The Fast Guide to Architectural Form, translated by Silvia Antonini, as reference no. 13 (Figs. 17-18 on arch-building typology).
Bibliography of a paper in volume B of the 3rd Panhellenic Conference lists Raffaelli (2016), The fast guide to architectural form, Bispublishers.

Romanian curriculum for Atelier de specialitate (grades IX-XII) lists The Fast Guide to Architectural Form (BIS Publishers, dated 2023 in the source) as recommended reading under 'Arte ambientale'; name appears in both orders (Baires, Raffaelli / Raffaelli Baires).
ACSA award statement (D. Buntrock) lists the Form book, pp. 16-17, in a student's ('Amy' Hay Mew Hwang, UC Berkeley) reference list.
Doctoral thesis by M. Aflalo (USP) lists the Form book (BIS, 2016) with the author's surname misspelled 'RAFAELLI'.
ENSA Clermont-Ferrand student guide 2022-23 lists the Form book (BIS, 2016) in the commented basic bibliography of four courses (pp. 78, 112, 146, 184).

Tosi & Pistolesi present 'La casa in via Pascoli' in Foligno (PG), 2006, designed by architect Baires Raffaelli, as a second example of accessible housing (115 sqm ground-floor flat with garden); Fig. 4.3 (floor plan) credits Arch. Baires Raffaelli, 2006; footnote 8 cites the Superabile article 'La casa in via Pascoli' as source.

Paper in the TFYD 2019 'Initiations' proceedings cites the Form book as ref. [2] (Introduction, translated by Silvia Antonini); a second copy of the book (file Initiations-FINAL-BOOK-optimized.pdf) shows the same reference at PDF p. 355.

Vilnius Academy of Arts master's thesis presents 'Pump it Up House' (inflatable emergency housing) as designed by Baires Raffaelli, Elio Rava, Paolo Moressoni and Tommaso Passalacqua; sources it to Europaconcorsi (2007), viewed 29 Nov 2012, project 24649. File 'download (4).pdf' is an identical copy.

ECORFAN book devotes section 2.8 (PDF p. 20) to The fast guide to architectural form, describing it as a visual guide presenting sixty forms; groups Raffaelli with Vyzoviti and Lim as recent experimental formal methodologies; reference at p. 91.
Open-access volume 'Design della comunicazione. Un ritratto disciplinare' lists Raffaelli, Baires 2020, The fast guide to Accessibility design (BIS Publishers) in a chapter bibliography.

Thames & Hudson Australia trade catalogue (June 2020, distributing BIS Publishers) lists The Fast Guide to Accessibility Design ('Bares Raffaelli'): 144 pp., 150x105 mm paperback, ISBN 9789063695712, AU$21.99.

Scholar Architect 2022 (UAUIM, Romanian) lists Raffaelli (2020) The Fast Guide to Accessibility Design and Raffaelli (2018) The Fast Guide to Architectural Form; the source dates the Form book 2018, whereas the first BIS edition is 2016.
English edition of Scholar Architect 2022 repeats both references (Accessibility Design 2020; Architectural Form dated 2018) on PDF p. 131.

Master's thesis by A. R. M. Cabral (Univ. do Minho, 2022) lists 'The fast guide to accessibility design' among its main references on housing accessibility for hearing and visual impairment (cf. Wikipedia pp. 14-15).

Master's thesis (Metropolia UAS, YAMK, 12 May 2022) cites Raffaelli 2020 at pp. 137, 142 and 153 of the book for web accessibility guidance (audio/text/video alternatives, readable font size); full reference at p. 76.

Programme of the seminar 'Progettare la città e il territorio accessibile a tutt*' (Perugia, Villa Umbra, 18 Dec 2019, 10:00-14:00) lists Baires Raffaelli (Festival città accessibili and Università La Sapienza) as speaker on the research on a quality mark for building accessibility; a different person, Giorgio Raffaelli, opens the session for the Festival per le Città Accessibili.

Printout of the English Wikipedia article, revision oldid=1292563278: Italian architect and author b. 1975, PhD Sapienza (Architecture, Theory and Planning); cites the Cabral thesis (UMinho handle 1822/79016) at pp. 14-15.
Earlier revision (oldid=1249910165) of the same English Wikipedia article; same biographical core.

Poster of the Ordine degli Architetti of Perugia: webinar 'Contemporaneità e forma architettonica', Fri 15 May 2020, 16:00-18:00 on GoToWebinar, guided analysis of the formal typology of buildings from The Fast Guide to Architectural Form; 2 CFP.

Poster of the Ordine degli Architetti of Perugia: webinar 'La città di ognuno. Il progetto per tutti', Wed 6 Oct 2021, 16:00-18:00, guided analysis of The Fast Guide to Accessibility Design; speakers Baires Raffaelli, Luigi Prestinenza Puglisi, Paolo Moressoni; 2 CFP.

Second version of the Villa Umbra programme (18 Dec 2019): same speaker listing; the session 'Superamento delle barriere all'abitare' starts at 10:30 (10:45 in the first version); individual talk times are not given.

CERPA Italia news item (from Superabile) on an accessible home in Foligno developed through a participatory process, with Baires Raffaelli on the latest renovation of the sleeping area; no street or year given.
Publisher page of Longsea (Taiwan): translator Qiu Xili, published 2022-02-25, 17x12.5 cm, 144 pages, paperback, NT$280, ISBN 9786269565818, code LS-0146.
ArchiDogs article presenting the four-volume series including the simplified-Chinese Form guide; contains a preface by Baires Raffaelli for the Chinese edition and a recommendation by Han Linfei.
Kasra publisher page (Wayback snapshot): translator Ali Javid, 144 pages, pocket size, paperback, published 1398 SH, second printing in 1404 SH, ISBN 9786006509952, 2,400,000 rials, in stock.

Photo supplied by the author of the back covers of two Longsea paperbacks; the yellow one (Form, traditional Chinese) shows ISBN 978-626-95658-1-8, price 280 and www.longsea.com.tw; the grey one is a different book.
